server.title: Server
server.tabs.label: Server pages
server.shutting_down: Foreman is shutting down. Try again once it is back.
server.none.heading: No active world
server.none.text: No world is active yet, so there is no server to run. Import a world or upload a save on the Worlds page; the first world becomes the active one.
server.players.heading: Players online
server.announce.unknown: Foreman cannot tell the server's state
server.unknown.unreachable: Foreman cannot reach Docker at {target} (DOCKER_HOST). Check that Docker, or the socket proxy, is running and that DOCKER_HOST points at it
server.unknown.docker: Foreman cannot reach Docker. The details are in Foreman's log.
server.unknown.inspect: Foreman cannot read the game container from Docker. The details are in Foreman's log.
server.unknown.password: Foreman cannot read this world's RCON password, so it cannot watch the game: {detail}
server.unknown.asking: Foreman is still asking Docker about the game.
server.unknown.paused: The game container is paused in Docker. Foreman never pauses it; unpause it with Docker.
server.players.cannot_see: Foreman cannot see whether anyone is online.
server.players.failed: Foreman could not ask the game who is online. It tries again with the next update.
server.players.not_listed_starting: Players are not listed while the server is starting.
server.players.not_listed_stopping: Players are not listed while the server is stopping.
server.players.not_running: Nobody can be online while the game is not running.
server.online.failed: Foreman could not ask the game who is online.
server.countdown.invalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from 0 to {max}
server.failure.undo_text: Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first. To put the world back as it was, restore that snapshot.
server.anyway.start_offer: You can start anyway; the choice is below.
server.anyway.restart_offer: You can restart anyway; the choice is below.
server.anyway.switch_offer: You can switch anyway; the choice is below.
server.anyway.update_offer: You can update anyway; the choice is below.
server.anyway.warn: Warn players online with a {countdown}-second countdown, save the game and stop it.
server.anyway.leave_stopped: Leave the server stopped, because it is not running now.
server.anyway.update.download: Download the game image for Factorio {version} first, if Foreman does not have it. If the download fails, nothing else happens.
server.anyway.update.set: Set the world's game version to {version}.
server.anyway.update.start: Start the game on {version}. It drops from the save whatever depends on the problems above, and the next time it saves, that is gone for good.
server.anyway.update.undo: To undo, use Roll back on the world's page.
server.anyway.switch.warn: Warn players online with a {countdown}-second countdown, save the game and stop {from}.
server.anyway.switch.snapshots: Take a snapshot of {from} and of {world}, both labeled "{label}", and one more of {world}, labeled "{anyway_label}". If a snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
server.anyway.switch.start: Start the game on {world}. It drops from the save whatever depends on the problems above, and the next time it saves, that is gone for good.
server.anyway.start.snapshot: Take a snapshot of {world}, labeled "{label}". If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
server.anyway.start.start: Start the game. It drops from the save whatever depends on the problems above, and the next time it saves, that is gone for good.
server.anyway.start.undo: To undo, restore that snapshot from the Snapshots page.
server.crash.no_reason: Foreman could not tell why from the log.
server.crash.fix: Fix what the game reported, for example {world}'s mods or its save, then try to start it again.
server.crash.fix_or: Fix what the game reported, for example {world}'s mods or its save, then try to start it again. Or put things back as they were before:
server.crash.console: Read the full log on the Console page
server.crash.loop.none: The game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it.
server.crash.loop.mods: The game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it: {reason}.
server.crash.loop.said: The game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it. Factorio said: {said}.
server.crash.loop_earlier_at.none: Earlier, at {time}: the game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it.
server.crash.loop_earlier_at.mods: Earlier, at {time}: the game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it: {reason}.
server.crash.loop_earlier_at.said: Earlier, at {time}: the game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it. Factorio said: {said}.
server.crash.loop_earlier.none: Earlier: the game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it.
server.crash.loop_earlier.mods: Earlier: the game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it: {reason}.
server.crash.loop_earlier.said: Earlier: the game crashed again and again, so Foreman stopped it. Factorio said: {said}.
server.crash.once_at.none: The game crashed at {time}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_at.mods: The game crashed at {time}: {reason}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_at.said: The game crashed at {time}. Factorio said: {said}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once.none: The game crashed. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once.mods: The game crashed: {reason}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once.said: The game crashed. Factorio said: {said}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_earlier_at.none: Earlier, at {time}: the game crashed. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_earlier_at.mods: Earlier, at {time}: the game crashed: {reason}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_earlier_at.said: Earlier, at {time}: the game crashed. Factorio said: {said}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_earlier.none: Earlier: the game crashed. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_earlier.mods: Earlier: the game crashed: {reason}. Docker is starting it again.
server.crash.once_earlier.said: Earlier: the game crashed. Factorio said: {said}. Docker is starting it again.

server.load.mods.one: {count} mod was made for Factorio {required}, and this game runs {current}
server.load.mods.other: {count} mods were made for Factorio {required}, and this game runs {current}

server.load.mods_named.one: {count} mod was made for Factorio {required}, and this game runs {current}: {names}
server.load.mods_named.other: {count} mods were made for Factorio {required}, and this game runs {current}: {names}

server.step.snapshot_anyway: Take a snapshot before starting anyway
server.step.load: Wait for the game to load
server.step.snapshot_update: Take the snapshot before the update
server.step.snapshot_both: Take a snapshot of both worlds
server.step.snapshot_mods: Take the snapshot before the mod change
server.notice.presented: {to} is active; the switch did not confirm it running.
server.notice.at_stop: Switch from {from} to {to} stopped at stopping {from}. {from} is still active and was not started again.
server.notice.at_snapshots: Switch from {from} to {to} stopped at the snapshots. {from} is still active and was not started again.
server.notice.at_check: Switch from {from} to {to} stopped at the check of {to}. {from} is still active and was not started again.
server.notice.at_present: Switch from {from} to {to} stopped at making {to} active. {from} is still active and was not started again.
server.notice.at_step: Switch from {from} to {to} stopped at step {step}. {from} is still active and was not started again.
server.blocked.crash_loop: {world} crashed again and again the last time it ran.
server.blocked.refused: Foreman refused the last start of {world}, for the reason above. Fix the world first, then try to start it again.
server.blocked.announce: Start server is replaced by Try to start again, for after the world is fixed.
server.image.missing_note: {world} runs on the game image {image}, which is not on this host, so it cannot start yet. Download it first; that pulls it from Docker Hub.
server.actions_note.unknown: Foreman cannot start or stop the game until it can ask Docker about it.
server.actions_note.switch: Wait for the switch to finish, or use Force stop. Force stop ends the switch; the game is stopped without saving.
server.actions_note.busy: Wait for this to finish, or use Force stop to stop the game now without saving.
server.actions_note.unsettled: The game is not in game, so it cannot be warned or saved. Wait, or use Force stop.
server.other.start: The start asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.stop: The stop asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.restart: The restart asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.force_stop: The forced stop asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.download: The image download asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.restore: The restore asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.switch: The switch asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.update: The update asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.mods: The mod change asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.rollback: The rollback asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.snapshot: The snapshot asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.other.action: The action asked for during another action did not finish: {why}
server.cancelled.switch: The switch to {to} was canceled. {world} is still the active world, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.stop: The stop was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.restart: The restart was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.restore: The restore was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.update: The update was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.mods: The mod change was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.rollback: The rollback was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.cancelled.action: The action was canceled. Nothing was saved or stopped, and nothing changed.
server.done.restore: The world is restored. Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first.
server.done.update: The game version is updated. Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first.
server.done.rollback: The world is rolled back. Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first.
server.done.switch: The worlds are switched, from {from} to {to}. Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" of both worlds first.
server.mods_done.kept: Foreman took no new snapshot: "{label}" from {time} undoes this change and the ones before it.
server.mods_failed.checksum: {mod} {version} did not match the checksum the mod portal publishes, so Foreman did not use it.
server.mods_failed.unauthorized: factorio.com refused the username or token, so {mod} {version} was not downloaded.
server.mods_failed.gone: The mod portal no longer has {mod} {version}.
server.mods_failed.download: {mod} {version} could not be downloaded from the mod portal.
server.mods_failed.kept_running: Nothing was changed, and {world} kept running.
server.mods_failed.stayed_stopped: Nothing was changed, and {world} stayed stopped.
server.precheck.changed: The world or the server changed since the page showed it, so Foreman did not go ahead. Read the message again before you choose.
server.portal_unchecked: Foreman could not reach the mod portal in time, so it did not check that players can download this world's mods.
server.precheck.start: Foreman did not start the game, because the save that would load does not match the world:
server.precheck.switch: Foreman did not switch, because the save that would load in the new world does not match that world:
server.precheck.start_cannot_run: Foreman did not start the game, because {world} cannot run in this game:
server.precheck.start_cannot_run_unnamed: Foreman did not start the game, because the world cannot run in this game:
server.precheck.switch_cannot_run: Foreman did not switch, because {world} cannot run in this game:
server.precheck.switch_cannot_run_unname: Foreman did not switch, because the world cannot run in this game:
server.precheck.update: Foreman did not update the game version, because the save does not match {world} on Factorio {version}:
server.precheck.update_cannot_run: Foreman did not update the game version, because {world} cannot run in Factorio {version}:
server.precheck.start_players: Foreman did not start the game, because players could not join it:
server.precheck.switch_players: Foreman did not switch, because players could not join the new world:
server.problem.game_version: The world is set to Factorio {version}. Foreman runs only Factorio 1.1, 2.0 and 2.1.
server.problem.no_save: The world has no save. Upload a save first; without one the game would make a new map.
server.problem.save_gone: The save chosen to load, {save}, is no longer in the world. Choose another save.
server.problem.save_unsupported: The save {save} was made by Factorio {save_version}. Foreman runs only saves from Factorio 1.1, 2.0 and 2.1.
server.problem.save_unreadable: Foreman could not read the save {save} ({detail}), so its mods could not be checked.
server.problem.modlist_space_age_on: Space Age is on for this world, but mod-list.json has {mods} turned off. Fix the mod list before starting.
server.problem.modlist_space_age_off: Space Age is off for this world, but mod-list.json has {mods} turned on (or is missing, so the game turns them on). Fix the mod list before starting.
server.problem.save_newer: The save {save} was made by Factorio {save_version}, newer than this world's Factorio {version}. An older game cannot load it.
server.problem.space_age_off: {save} uses Space Age ({mods}), but Space Age is off for this world.
server.problem.mod_missing_one: {save} uses {mods}, but this world has no file for it.
server.problem.mod_missing_many: {save} uses {mods}, but this world has no files for them.
server.problem.mod_disabled_one: {save} uses {mods}, but it is disabled in this world.
server.problem.mod_disabled_many: {save} uses {mods}, but they are disabled in this world.
server.problem.mod_gone_one: The mod portal no longer has {mod} {version}, so players' games cannot download it and they cannot join. Going ahead anyway deletes nothing from the save.
server.problem.mod_gone_many: The mod portal no longer has {mods}, so players' games cannot download them and they cannot join. Going ahead anyway deletes nothing from the save.

server.problem.mod_version_first.one: {world} cannot run on Factorio {version}: {count} of its mods was made for Factorio {for}, and the game refuses to load it: {names}.
server.problem.mod_version_first.other: {world} cannot run on Factorio {version}: {count} of its mods were made for Factorio {for}, and the game refuses to load them: {names}.

server.problem.mod_version_more.one: {count} of its mods was made for Factorio {for}, and the game refuses to load it: {names}.
server.problem.mod_version_more.other: {count} of its mods were made for Factorio {for}, and the game refuses to load them: {names}.

server.problem.mod_version_update_game: Update the world's game version to a {line} release, or update its mods.
server.problem.mod_version_update_mods: Update its mods to versions made for Factorio {line}.
server.error.countdown: The stop countdown must be between 0 and 10 minutes.
server.error.docker_unreachable: Foreman cannot reach Docker at {target} (DOCKER_HOST). Check that Docker, or the socket proxy, is running and that DOCKER_HOST points at it. Nothing was done.
server.error.docker_down: Foreman cannot reach Docker, so nothing was done. Check that Docker is running and that Foreman can reach it, then try again.
server.error.unfinished: Foreman could not finish this. The details are in Foreman's log.
server.error.cancelled_stopped: A forced stop interrupted this. It stopped the game of {world}.
server.error.cancelled_none: A forced stop interrupted this. No game of {world} was running.
server.error.not_active_named: {world} is not the active world. Switch to it first.
server.error.already_running: The game is already running. Stop it first.
server.error.not_ready: The game is starting or restarting after a crash. Wait until it is running, or stop it, then try again.
server.error.image_missing: The game image for this world's Factorio version is not downloaded. Download the game image, then start again.
server.error.rcon_unreachable: Cannot reach the game over RCON, so it cannot warn players or save first. Use Force stop to stop it without saving.
server.error.save_timeout: The game did not finish saving in time, so nothing was stopped or snapshotted. Try again, or use Force stop.
server.error.stop_cancelled: The stop was canceled, so nothing was stopped or saved and the game runs on.
server.error.no_countdown: There is no stop countdown to cancel. It may have just ended.
server.error.downloading: The game image is already being downloaded.
server.error.foreign: A Docker container with this world's container name exists, but Foreman did not create it. Rename or remove that container, then try again.
server.error.paused: The game container is paused in Docker. Foreman never pauses it; unpause it with Docker, then try again.
server.error.network: The game network cannot be used.
server.error.save_in_future: Another save in this world has a modification time in the future, so the chosen save cannot be made the one that loads. Fix the computer's clock or remove that save.
server.error.switch_same: This is already the active world.
server.error.switch_not_active: The world to switch from is no longer the active world. Reload the page, then try again.
server.error.switch_no_target: The world to switch to does not exist.
server.error.switch_target_running: The world to switch to already has a game running. Stop it first.
server.error.switch_no_active: No world is active, so there is nothing to switch from.
server.error.switch_unreadable: The world.json of the world to switch to cannot be read, so that world cannot start.
server.error.switch_newer: A newer version of Foreman wrote the world to switch to, so this version cannot start it.
server.error.switch_busy: Another operation is running on one of these worlds. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
server.error.switch_unsettled: The game is starting or stopping, or Foreman cannot tell its state. Wait until it is running or stopped, or use Force stop.
server.error.switch_unavailable: Switching worlds is not set up in this Foreman.
server.error.not_active: The world is not the active world. Switch to it first.
server.error.version_not_newer: The version to update to must be newer than the world's current version.
server.error.version_unsupported: Enter an exact Factorio release of 1.1, 2.0 or 2.1, such as 2.0.72.
server.error.no_rollback: There is no snapshot from before an update to an older version to roll back to.
server.start.not_active: Only the active world can be started. This world is not the active one.
server.start.load_failed: The game did not start: it could not load the save.
server.start.load_failed_said: The game did not start: it could not load the save ({said}).
server.start.said: The game did not start. Factorio said: {said}.
server.start.stopped_loading: The game did not start: the game stopped while it was loading.
server.start.load_timeout: The game did not start: it did not finish loading within {wait}.
server.start.rcon_timeout: The game did not start: it is in game but did not answer over RCON within {wait}.
server.start.rcon_refused: The game did not start: the game is in game, but it refused Foreman's RCON password.
server.network.unset: FOREMAN_GAME_NETWORK must be set when Foreman runs in a container: it names the Docker network the game joins. Choose a network Foreman is on that the Docker socket proxy is not on.
server.network.not_joined: FOREMAN_GAME_NETWORK names the "{network}" network, but the Foreman container is not on it, so Foreman could not reach the game. Connect Foreman to that network, or name one it is on.
server.network.no_range: Cannot read the address range of the "{network}" network from Docker, so Foreman cannot check that a game on it stays away from the Docker socket proxy and FOREMAN_TRUSTED_PROXIES. Check that Docker answers, then try again.
server.network.proxy_overlap: The game network "{network}" ({subnet}) overlaps FOREMAN_TRUSTED_PROXIES ({proxies}), so a game could pose as the proxy that signs users in. Use a game network outside those ranges, or narrow FOREMAN_TRUSTED_PROXIES.
server.network.shared: Foreman will not start a game on the network "{network}" while other containers are on it, because a game could reach them. On it now: {members}.
server.network.member.other: {name} (a {state} container that is not a Foreman game)
server.network.member.other_stopped: {name} (a stopped container that is not a Foreman game)
server.network.member.install_stopped: {name} (a stopped game from another Foreman installation)
server.network.remove: Remove the stopped ones you no longer need with "{command}".
server.network.shared_end: Then try again. If they must stay, give Foreman a game network of its own with FOREMAN_GAME_NETWORK.
server.network.host_lookup: DOCKER_HOST uses tcp://, but Foreman cannot look up the address of "{host}", so it cannot check that a game on the "{network}" network could not reach the Docker socket proxy. Check DOCKER_HOST, then try again.
server.network.host_address: DOCKER_HOST uses tcp://, but "{host}" gave the address "{address}", which Foreman cannot read, so it cannot check that a game could not reach the Docker socket proxy. Check DOCKER_HOST, then try again.
server.network.host_on_game: DOCKER_HOST reaches the Docker socket proxy at {address}, which is on the game network "{network}" ({subnet}), so a game could reach it. Put the game on a network of its own that Foreman also joins and the proxy does not.
server.network.host_outside: DOCKER_HOST reaches Docker at {address}, which is not on any of Foreman's networks other than the game network "{network}", so a game might reach it through that network's gateway. Reach Docker over a network the game is not on, such as a socket proxy on a network Foreman shares with it.
server.network.self_file: Foreman seems to run in a container ({file} exists), but Docker has no container with Foreman's ID or hostname, so Foreman cannot tell which networks it is on. Keep the hostname Docker gave the Foreman container, and make sure DOCKER_HOST reaches the Docker that runs Foreman.
server.network.self_tcp: Foreman seems to run in a container (DOCKER_HOST uses tcp://), but Docker has no container with Foreman's ID or hostname, so Foreman cannot tell which networks it is on. Keep the hostname Docker gave the Foreman container, and make sure DOCKER_HOST reaches the Docker that runs Foreman.
server.download.failed: Foreman could not download {image}. The details are in Foreman's log. Try again.
server.download.failed_switch: Foreman could not download {image}. The details are in Foreman's log. Try the switch again.
server.download.no_image: Foreman could not download {image}: Docker Hub has no image with that version.
server.download.no_image_advice: Check the world's game version on its page.
server.stop.title: Stop the server
server.stop.heading: Stop {world}
server.stop.text: Foreman warns players online, saves the game, then stops it. Nothing is lost.
server.stop.restart_text: Foreman warns players online, saves the game, stops it and starts the same world again.
server.force.title: Force stop {world}
server.force.heading: Force stop the game running {world}?
server.force.at_once: Stop the game at once, without warning players and without saving.
server.force.lose: Lose all progress since the last save.
server.force.lose_since: Lose all progress since the last save, made at {time}.
server.force.interrupt: Interrupt any start, stop, restart, restore or switch that is running now. A switch that is interrupted does not finish.
server.force.no_snapshot: Take no snapshot: nothing in the world's folder is changed.
server.switch.title: Switch to {world}
server.switch.heading: Switch from {from} to {to}?
server.switch.download: Download the game image {image}, because this host does not have it. If the download fails, nothing else happens.
server.switch.download_running: Download the game image {image}, because this host does not have it. If the download fails, nothing else happens and {from} keeps running.
server.switch.download_size: Download the game image {image}, about {size}, because this host does not have it. If the download fails, nothing else happens.
server.switch.download_size_running: Download the game image {image}, about {size}, because this host does not have it. If the download fails, nothing else happens and {from} keeps running.
server.switch.warn: Warn players online with the countdown below, save the game and stop {from}.
server.switch.snapshots: Take a snapshot of {from} and of {to}, both labeled "{label}". If a snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
server.switch.with_anyway: With "Switch and start anyway": take one more snapshot of {to}, labeled "{label}", and start the game on {to}. It drops from the save whatever depends on the problems above, and the next time it saves, that is gone for good.
server.switch.with_stopped: With "Switch, leave stopped": leave the server stopped. The next Start shows these problems again, so you can fix them first.
server.switch.start_if: Start the game on {to} if the box below is ticked; otherwise leave the server stopped.
server.switch.problems_lead: The save that would load in {world} does not match that world:
server.switch.no_from: The form does not say which world is active. Go back, reload the page and try again.
server.switch.note_refused: {world} is still the active world, and nothing changed.
server.switch.note_presented: {world} is now the active world, but the switch did not finish.
server.switch.note_none: Nothing was switched. {world} is still the active world.
server.update.title: Update {world}
server.update.heading: Update {world} from Factorio {version}?
server.update.forward: A game version only moves forward. To go back, use Roll back on the world's page.
server.update.typed_hint: Three numbers newer than {version}. If you type one, it is used instead of the choice above.
server.update.download: Download the new version's game image first, if Foreman does not have it. If the download fails, nothing else happens.
server.update.warn: Warn players online with the countdown below, save the game and stop it.
server.update.set: Set the world's game version to the new one.
server.update.start: Start the game again on the new version. The Server page shows each step.
server.update.undo: To undo, use Roll back on the world's page. Play after the update is lost when you roll back.
server.rollback.title: Roll back {world}
server.rollback.heading: Go back from Factorio {from} to {to}?
server.rollback.warning: everything played since the update is lost. Saves made on {from} cannot be loaded by {to}.
server.rollback.snapshot: Take a snapshot of {world}, labeled "{label}". If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
server.rollback.restore: Restore the snapshot "{label}" from {time}, which puts the world back on Factorio {version}.
server.rollback.start: Start the game again on {version}. The Server page shows each step.
server.rollback.undo: To undo, restore the "{label}" snapshot from the Snapshots page.
server.rollback.undo_note: Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first; to undo, restore it from the Snapshots page.
server.rollback.unfinished: Foreman could not finish the rollback.
server.restore.title: Restore a snapshot of {world}
server.restore.heading: Restore the snapshot "{label}" from {time}?

server.restore.recreate.one: Foreman will recreate this world from the snapshot: the folder {folder} with the {count} files in this snapshot ({size}), with their original modification times.
server.restore.recreate.other: Foreman will recreate this world from the snapshot: the folder {folder} with the {count} files in this snapshot ({size}), with their original modification times.

server.restore.stop_first: First, stop the game: warn players online with the countdown below, save, then stop. If the game cannot be saved, nothing else happens.
server.restore.then_snapshot: Then take a snapshot of {world}, labeled "{label}". If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
server.restore.first_snapshot: First, take a snapshot of {world}, labeled "{label}". If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.

server.restore.replace.one: Replace everything in the folder {folder} with the {count} files in this snapshot ({size}), with their original modification times. Saves made since the snapshot will be gone from the world.
server.restore.replace.other: Replace everything in the folder {folder} with the {count} files in this snapshot ({size}), with their original modification times. Saves made since the snapshot will be gone from the world.

server.restore.start: Start the game again with the restored world. The Server page shows each step.
server.restore.keep_undo: Keep this snapshot. To undo, restore the "{label}" snapshot from the Snapshots page.
server.restore.cancel: Cancel, keep the world as it is
